class.name: HTMLDocumentFragment
class.brief_description: A detached collection of HTML elements for batch insertion.
class.description: Create a fragment with [method HTMLLayout.create_document_fragment] or [method HTMLLabel.create_document_fragment]. Add elements from the same layout with [method append_child]. Insert them through [method HTMLElement.append_fragment] or [method HTMLElement.insert_fragment_before]. A successful insertion preserves the element handles and empties the fragment for reuse. Direct children are detached from the document and return [code]null[/code] from [method HTMLElement.get_parent] while in the fragment. Clearing or reparsing the layout invalidates the fragment and the handles it still holds.

method.name: append_child
method.description: Moves [param child] to the end of the fragment. If the child was connected, its removal schedules a document update. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for an invalid fragment or child, a child from a different layout, or the document root.

method.name: get_children
method.description: Returns a snapshot of the direct children in order, or an empty array if the fragment is invalid.
